message:
`this` should be an `{expression}`. Using a string attribute value will cause an error in future versions of Svelte
https://svelte.dev/e/svelte_element_invalid_this

`<svelte:element>` with a click handler must have an ARIA role
https://svelte.dev/e/a11y_no_static_element_interactions

Using `on:click` to listen to the click event is deprecated. Use the event attribute `onclick` instead
https://svelte.dev/e/event_directive_deprecated
